derivedBy: hand, from the stated dimensions in l-bracket.design.md; never regenerated from napkin's output

overall.derivation: The extreme corners of every box, worked out in inches then x1024.

boxes.name: Foot
boxes.derivation: The base plate, 6" x 4" x 1/2", lifted 1/4" by the skid; offset 1/2" in X and Y so every feature has room on every side. x 1/2..6 1/2, y 1/2..4 1/2, z 1/4..3/4.

boxes.name: Upright
boxes.derivation: The upright of the L on the foot's west edge: 1/2" thick across X, 4" wide up Y, 5 1/4" tall (its depth) on the foot's top at 3/4": z 3/4..6. x 1/2..1.

boxes.name: Boss, top
boxes.derivation: A 1" cube on top of the foot at its south-east corner: x 5 1/2..6 1/2, y 1/2..1 1/2, z 3/4..1 3/4. The only feature seen from above beyond the L itself.

boxes.name: Skid, bottom
boxes.derivation: A 1" x 1" x 1/4" skid under the foot's middle, on the floor: x 3..4, y 2..3, z 0..1/4. Seen only from below.

boxes.name: Tab, east
boxes.derivation: A 1" x 1" x 1/2" tab continuing the foot beyond its east edge (foot ends at 6 1/2): x 6 1/2..7 1/2, y 2..3, z 1/4..3/4. Only the east side shows it.

boxes.name: Nub, west
boxes.derivation: A nub on the upright's west face (x 1/2): 1/2" thick across X, 1" wide up Y, 3/4" tall (depth): x 0..1/2, y 2..3, z 3..3 3/4.

boxes.name: Rib, north
boxes.derivation: A rib on the upright's north face (y 4 1/2): 1/2" x 1/2" in plan, 2" tall: x 1/2..1, y 4 1/2..5, z 2..4.

boxes.name: Lug, south
boxes.derivation: A lug on the upright's south face (y 1/2): 1/2" x 1/2" in plan, 1" tall, higher than the rib so front and back differ: x 1/2..1, y 0..1/2, z 4..5.

cutList.label: Upright
cutList.derivation: Stands up: length its depth 5 1/4" = 5376, width 4" = 4096, thickness 1/2" = 512.

cutList.label: Boss, top
cutList.derivation: 1" cube = 1024 each way. Among the 1"-long pieces: widest (1") and thickest (1") first.

cutList.label: Tab, east
cutList.derivation: 1" x 1" x 1/2" = 1024 x 1024 x 512. Same length and width as the boss, thinner, so after it.

cutList.label: Skid, bottom
cutList.derivation: 1" x 1" x 1/4" = 1024 x 1024 x 256. Thinnest of the 1" x 1" pieces, so after the tab.

cutList.label: Lug, south
cutList.derivation: Length its depth 1" = 1024, width 1/2" = 512, thickness 1/2" = 512. Narrower than the 1"-wide pieces, so after them.

cutList.label: Nub, west
cutList.derivation: Length its depth 3/4" = 768, width 1" = 1024, thickness 1/2" = 512. Shortest, last.

cutListCsv: Cut list: finished sizes: joinery allowances included; before saw kerf (#138).
